covenants.detail: Minimum Debt Service Coverage Ratio of 1.25x, tested quarterly on a trailing twelve month basis.
covenants.clause: Section 6.02(a) of the Credit Agreement: Borrower shall maintain a Debt Service Coverage Ratio of not less than 1.25 to 1.00.
covenants.notes: DSCR defined as (EBITDA less unfinanced capital expenditure less cash taxes less distributions) divided by total scheduled debt service including the capital lease obligations.

evaluations.comments: Q1 2026 test at 1.18x, below the 1.25x minimum. Fuel surcharge recovery lagged the January diesel spike by one billing cycle. Waived by the credit officer on 30 April 2026; see policy exception CI-DSC-01.
Q2 2026 test at 1.31x, back in compliance once the surcharge caught up.
Q3 2026 test period open. Certificate due 30 October 2026.

covenants.detail: Maximum senior funded debt to tangible net worth of 3.50x, tested quarterly.
covenants.clause: Section 6.02(b) of the Credit Agreement: Borrower shall not permit Senior Funded Debt to Tangible Net Worth to exceed 3.50 to 1.00.
covenants.notes: Senior funded debt excludes subordinated shareholder notes. Tangible net worth excludes goodwill arising on the 2026 competitor acquisition.

evaluations.comments: Q1 2026 test at 2.21x after the acquisition draw, compliant.

covenants.detail: Borrowing base availability: advances under the revolving line may not exceed 80 percent of eligible receivables plus 50 percent of eligible inventory. Certificate due monthly within 20 days of month end.
covenants.clause: Section 2.04 of the Credit Agreement and Schedule 2.04 (Borrowing Base Definition).
covenants.notes: Eligibility excludes receivables over 90 days, cross-aged accounts where more than 25 percent of the obligor balance is over 90 days, and any single obligor concentration above 15 percent.

evaluations.comments: May 2026 certificate. Advances at 61 percent of the base, availability $4.4MM.
June 2026 certificate. Advances at 64 percent of the base.
July 2026 certificate. Advances at 65 percent of the base, availability $4.2MM.

covenants.detail: Minimum unrestricted liquidity of $2,000,000, being unrestricted cash plus availability under the revolving line, tested quarterly.
covenants.notes: Liquidity counts unrestricted operating cash and undrawn availability under the borrowing base. Restricted fuel-tax escrow is excluded.

reviews.narrative: FY2025 annual credit review of the Meridian relationship, prepared ahead of the 8 October 2026 review date. Grade affirmed at 5.
reviews.summary: Meridian group: $30.7MM committed across nine booked facilities in three packages, $25.08MM outstanding, plus a $5.0MM proposed distribution centre mortgage in credit underwriting. Secured by a first blanket lien on receivables, inventory and a 212-unit rolling stock fleet, and first mortgages on the Pooler warehouse and the Garden City cross-dock. Guaranteed by Meridian Holdings Inc and both principals, unlimited.
reviews.recommendation: Renew the $12.0MM revolving line at WSJ Prime plus 0.35 percent for a further twenty four months. Hold the grade at 5. Approve the Jacksonville distribution centre mortgage subject to a satisfactory appraisal and a clean Phase I.
reviews.riskComments: Risk grade affirmed at 5. Senior leverage of 2.08x and DSCR of 1.31x are both inside covenant. The single Q1 2026 DSC miss was a timing effect on fuel surcharge recovery and was waived; the ratio recovered the following quarter without structural change.
reviews.strengths: Fifteen year operating history under the founding management team. Contracted volume with three investment grade shippers covering 61 percent of revenue. Owner-occupied real estate with $2.5MM of equity above the mortgages. Fleet age of 3.1 years against an industry median of 5.4.
reviews.weaknesses: Customer concentration with the top five shippers at 68 percent of revenue. Diesel price exposure that is only partially recovered through surcharge, which is what caused the Q1 covenant miss. Integration risk on the Tidewater Drayage acquisition, which is still running on separate dispatch.

riskRatingReviews.comments: Annual risk rating review supporting the FY2025 annual review. Computed grade 5, no override requested.

policyExceptions.name: Debt service coverage below policy minimum, Q1 2026
mitigation: Fuel surcharge recovery lagged the January 2026 diesel spike by one billing cycle; the ratio recovered to 1.31x by Q2 without any change to structure.
Unlimited guaranties from Meridian Holdings Inc and both principals remain in place and unimpaired.
Borrowing base availability never fell below $3.9MM through the period, and no advance ever exceeded the base.

policyExceptions.name: Second-lien advance rate on receivables above guideline
mitigation: The acquisition loan is underwritten to cash flow, not to the borrowing base; the second lien is taken for control rather than for coverage.
Combined first and second advances remain inside 100 percent of eligible receivables at every month end tested.
